original: 私たちは飛行機から目に入る島々が本当に美しいと思った。

en.text: Seeing these islands from the airplane, we thought that they were really beautiful.

original: 数学は彼女の大好きな科目です。

en.text: Math is her favorite subject in school.

original: 彼女の車は二年目です。

en.text: Her car is two years old.

original: 彼は目が青い。

en.text: He has blue eyes.

original: 外を眺める者は夢を見るが、内を眺める者は目を覚ます。

en.text: Those who look outward dream, but those who look inward awaken.

original: 私たちは昨日、十年目の結婚記念日を祝った。

en.text: We celebrated our tenth wedding anniversary yesterday.

original: 目蓋には淡い日の光、ゆるやかな色合いが部屋の中を染める。

en.text: Dim sunbeams on my eyelids, a faint tinge dyes the room.

original: 彼は黒目の黒髪です。

en.text: He has dark eyes and dark hair.

original: 目が焼けるように痛い。

en.text: My eyes are burning.

original: 今日の朝も子供の泣き声で目が覚めた。

en.text: This morning, I woke up yet again to the sound of crying children.

original: 私は目が悪い。

en.text: I have bad eyes.

original: 目が悪いの？

en.text: Are your eyes bad?

original: 人間が直接感じ取る唯一の電磁波の波長は、目で見る光と肌を温まる赤外線ですか。

en.text: Are the only electromagnetic wavelengths that humans can directly perceive the light we see using our eyes and infrared radiation that warms our skin?

original: ３時間目の授業中です。

en.text: I'm in my third period class.

original: 教室を抜け出す少年の姿が目に入った。

en.text: I caught sight of the boy escaping from the classroom.

original: 朝食を食べると目が覚めて体が起きるんだ。

en.text: Eating breakfast really wakes me up.

original: １万円の追加料金を払う羽目になった。

en.text: We had to pay an additional ten thousand yen.

original: 車の営業は何年目？

en.text: How many years have you been selling cars?

original: 目玉焼きが朝の定番。

en.text: Fried eggs are a morning staple.
Fried eggs, sunny-side up, are a morning staple.

original: 一番好きな科目は、数学です。

en.text: My favourite subject is maths.
My favorite subject is math.

original: 仕事に行く時間に目が覚めた。

en.text: I woke up just in time to go to work.

original: 娘が学校で一番好きな科目は、美術です。

en.text: My daughter's favourite subject at school is art.

original: この科目が最も重要だ。

en.text: This subject is the most important.
